scope: UI learning record crew badge model

atoms.statement: Primary bottom nav is HOME/홈, EXPLORE/탐험, CATCH/보물함 with small English above Korean primary.
Home displays Ready-provided daily exploration goal and newly acquired items from reviewed homework/photo intake.
First TRACE is NEW-only; review TRACE is a distinct variant that may mix prior/re-hidden/current items.
TRACE is fast, think-first, game-like, low-input, non-punitive; full spelling entry is not default.
LINK uses principle/verified relation, related-choice discrimination, then mixed connection test with tap pairing.
PIECE is final missing critical-structure completion and is subject-adaptive, not English-only.
CATCH contains Items, Badge Book, Calendar, Item Detail and contextual memory-state views over shared learning history.
Learning item history is cumulative across missions; later review may reuse prior lexical/sense history.
Memory Ladder is contextual from Home/CATCH/completion, not a bottom tab.
Global badge policy/catalog/thresholds remain shared/Snap-family-owned; Hide emits evidence and renders shared awards.
Badge awards use a dedicated cross-app overlay/window at meaningful transitions; badge growth and history are visible in Badge Book.
Calendar is a non-punitive history view, never a streak-pressure mechanic.
Badge humor may include mistakes/retries/confusion but must target situation/world/crew, never learner ability or identity.
Snap owns crew identity/personality/intervention grammar; Hide consumes character_id and contextual appearance slots.
Hide crew slots are pre-start, walkie-talkie, context reaction, LINK support, PIECE support, CATCH/badge, completion.
Ready owns goals/dates/planner/family completion sharing; Hide owns pre-start sharing, specialist learning, and completion report.
Ultra-high-density illustration is required but interaction layer remains calm; emoji-first and generic wallpaper treatment are avoided.
Runtime V2 linear stage lineage remains internal evidence and is not mandatory learner-facing navigation.
